subproblem.title: Finite measures with equal integrals of smooth test functions supported in U agree on U
subproblem.statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝⁿ be open, and let μ, ν be finite Borel measures on ℝⁿ. Suppose ∫ b dμ = ∫ b dν for every b : ℝⁿ → ℝ that is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)), has compact support and satisfies tsupport b ⊆ U. Then the restrictions agree: μ⌞U = ν⌞U (μ.restrict U = ν.restrict U).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid n)), IsOpen U → IsFiniteMeasure μ → IsFiniteMeasure ν → (∀ b : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → ∫ y, b y ∂μ = ∫ y, b y ∂ν) → μ.restrict U = ν.restrict U
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps 3–4 of the parent proof (dominated convergence along smooth cutoffs of O ∩ U, then uniqueness of finite measures from the π-system of open sets). In the parent, σ₁ = μ₁⌞U and σ₂ = μ₂⌞U. Here the argument is run for arbitrary finite μ and ν, and the conclusion is stated for their restrictions to U, so no "carried by U" hypothesis is needed.
1. (Cutoffs for O ∩ U.) Let O ⊆ ℝⁿ be open and put V := O ∩ U; V is open, hence Borel measurable. By the sibling theorem Submission.cbr_ci_pw_noi_smooth_cutoff_seq applied to V, there are b_j : ℝⁿ → ℝ (j ∈ ℕ), each ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) with compact support, tsupport b_j ⊆ V and 0 ≤ b_j ≤ 1, such that b_j(y) → 1_V(y) for every y ∈ ℝⁿ.
2. (Limits of the test integrals.) Let ρ be any finite measure on ℝⁿ. Each b_j is continuous, hence a.e.-strongly measurable; |b_j(y)| ≤ 1 for all j and y; the constant function 1 is ρ-integrable because ρ is finite (integrable_const); and b_j → 1_V pointwise everywhere. By dominated convergence (tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence with bound 1), ∫ b_j dρ → ∫ 1_V dρ = ρ.real(V) = (ρ V).toReal (integral_indicator_one, V measurable).
3. (μ and ν agree on O ∩ U.) Because tsupport b_j ⊆ V ⊆ U and b_j is smooth with compact support, the hypothesis gives ∫ b_j dμ = ∫ b_j dν for every j. By step 2 for ρ = μ and ρ = ν, this single real sequence converges both to μ.real(V) and to ν.real(V). By uniqueness of limits (tendsto_nhds_unique), μ.real(V) = ν.real(V). As μ(V) < ∞ and ν(V) < ∞, μ(V) = ν(V) (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' with measure_ne_top). Thus μ(O ∩ U) = ν(O ∩ U) for every open O.
4. (The restrictions agree on open sets and on ℝⁿ.) For open O, (μ⌞U)(O) = μ(O ∩ U) and (ν⌞U)(O) = ν(O ∩ U) (Measure.restrict_apply, O measurable), so (μ⌞U)(O) = (ν⌞U)(O) by step 3. Taking O = ℝⁿ gives (μ⌞U)(ℝⁿ) = μ(U) = ν(U) = (ν⌞U)(ℝⁿ) (Measure.restrict_apply_univ).
5. (Uniqueness.) The open subsets of ℝⁿ form a π-system (isPiSystem_isOpen). It generates the σ-algebra of ℝⁿ, which is the Borel σ-algebra borel ℝⁿ = generateFrom {open sets} (BorelSpace.measurable_eq). The measure μ⌞U is finite since μ is. Two measures, the first finite, that agree on a generating π-system and on the whole space coincide (MeasureTheory.ext_of_generate_finite with C = {s | IsOpen s}). By step 4, μ⌞U = ν⌞U. ∎

Appendix (reference only): a Lean script of exactly this argument. It was checked with `lake env lean` after `import GMT.Ch07.Submission`, inside `namespace GMT.Ch07` with the frozen contract's `open`s (project b4d606db, Mathlib 25730c7c), inserted before `main_theorem` and after the sibling theorem. It compiles without `sorry` and uses only the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
```lean
theorem Submission.cbr_ci_pw_noi_restrict_eq_of_smooth_test : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid n)), IsOpen U → IsFiniteMeasure μ → IsFiniteMeasure ν → (∀ b : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → ∫ y, b y ∂μ = ∫ y, b y ∂ν) → μ.restrict U = ν.restrict U := by
  intro n U μ ν hU hμ hν htest
  -- the two measures agree on `O ∩ U` for every open `O`
  have hopen : ∀ O : Set (Euclid n), IsOpen O → μ (O ∩ U) = ν (O ∩ U) := by
    intro O hO
    obtain ⟨b, hbs, hbc, hbt, hb01, hblim⟩ :=
      Submission.cbr_ci_pw_noi_smooth_cutoff_seq n (O ∩ U) (hO.inter hU)
    have hlim : ∀ ρ : Measure (Euclid n), IsFiniteMeasure ρ →
        Tendsto (fun j => ∫ y, b j y ∂ρ) atTop (𝓝 (ρ.real (O ∩ U))) := by
      intro ρ hρ
      rw [← integral_indicator_one (hO.inter hU).measurableSet]
      refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
        (fun j => (hbs j).continuous.aestronglyMeasurable) (integrable_const 1)
        (fun j => Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_) (Eventually.of_forall hblim)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith [(hb01 j y).1, (hb01 j y).2]
    have heq : ∀ j, ∫ y, b j y ∂μ = ∫ y, b j y ∂ν := fun j =>
      htest (b j) (hbs j) (hbc j) ((hbt j).trans inter_subset_right)
    have h1 := hlim μ hμ
    have h2 := hlim ν hν
    simp_rw [heq] at h1
    exact (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (measure_ne_top _ _) (measure_ne_top _ _)).mp
      (tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2)
  -- uniqueness of finite measures agreeing on the π-system of open sets
  have := hμ
  refine ext_of_generate_finite {s | IsOpen s} BorelSpace.measurable_eq isPiSystem_isOpen ?_ ?_
  · intro s hs
    have hs' : IsOpen s := hs
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply hs'.measurableSet, Measure.restrict_apply hs'.measurableSet]
    exact hopen s hs'
  · rw [Measure.restrict_apply_univ, Measure.restrict_apply_univ]
    simpa using hopen univ isOpen_univ
```
proof_key_steps: For open O and V := O ∩ U, take the sibling cutoffs b_j → 1_V (smooth, compact support, tsupport b_j ⊆ V ⊆ U, 0 ≤ b_j ≤ 1).
Dominated convergence with bound 1 (finite measure): ∫ b_j dρ → ρ(V) for ρ = μ and ρ = ν.
The hypothesis gives ∫ b_j dμ = ∫ b_j dν, so μ(O ∩ U) = ν(O ∩ U) (finite values) for every open O, including O = ℝⁿ.
μ⌞U and ν⌞U agree on the π-system of open sets generating the Borel σ-algebra and on ℝⁿ, so ext_of_generate_finite gives μ⌞U = ν⌞U.
